actions.action: Check whether pets could be chewing the plants
Inspect leaf undersides, joints and soil surface with a flashlight in the evening for pests
Check whether leaves are being handled or are near a vent, door or windy window
Check soil moisture with a finger before watering; water only when top 2 inches are dry
Make sure pots drain well and don't sit in water
Move plants closer to a bright window
